### Advisory reports

A non-empty result is a finding, one row per finding (`audit_health` and `audit_erasure` are inventories). Their columns may change in any revision.

| Name | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `audit_array_id_coherence` | Coherence of array_id, the dense-array row handle |
| `audit_array_integrity` | Array-integrity |
| `audit_array_payload_xor` | Retained-row payload XOR |
| `audit_axis_integrity` | Axis-content integrity |
| `audit_class_set_entity_name_dup` | Entity-name uniqueness across a class-set's members (#2364 — cross-table, so a view rather than an index) |
| `audit_cross_tier_duplicate` | Cross-tier duplicate audit |
| `audit_dangling_ref` | Referential integrity (FK-intent fallback) |
| `audit_dangling_semantic_ref` | Semantic_annotation FK intent (view-validated, not engine-enforced) |
| `audit_element_arity` | Element arity (the #1015 import-typo class) |
| `audit_element_class_mismatch` | Element class conformance (set-typed dimensions accept entities of any member class; class-typed accept that class) |
| `audit_entity_alternative_redundant` | Redundant activation rows (#3010) |
| `audit_erasure` | Erasure inventory (reporting, NOT blocking — unlike the audit_* views above, a non-empty result is not damage: it is the truthful record that hard erasure … |
| `audit_health` | Maintenance-health audit |
| `audit_history_tiling` | Version-tiling + span coherence |
| `audit_index_accelerator` | Index-accelerator audit |
| `audit_long_value_coherence` | Long-value coherence audit |
| `audit_membership_cycle` | Membership cycles (an accepted residual risk, surfaced) |
| `audit_metadata_reserved_dup` | Reserved single-valued metadata keys must not fork |
| `audit_missing_required_value` | Required parameters (#2710) on active entities with neither a resolved value nor a definition default (default_value is the resolution fallback, #1598) — … |
| `audit_position_range` | Long-tier positions must fall inside the bound axis (otherwise an out-of-range iN_pos would escape every audit and render a NULL index) |
| `audit_realizes_cycle` | Refinement (realizes) cycles (sibling of the membership-cycle audit) |
| `audit_required_class_empty` | Required classes (#3133) with no active entity in the resolved scenario |
| `audit_scenario_empty` | A scenario resolving to zero alternatives is a red-flag view result, not a crash downstream (#3036) |
| `audit_tier_intent` | Tier-intent audit |
| `audit_type_conformance` | Type-conformance |
| `audit_value_class_mismatch` | Values whose definition belongs to a different class than the entity |
| `audit_value_list_membership` | Value-list membership (writer-checked at entry, audited here) |
